title: Unit 14 Consolidation: Whoever, Whatever, Wherever
goal: Review the universal relatives, however much and whatever it is, and formal Spanish, and read a short text about Rivera and La vorágine.
grammar: Review of universal relatives and formal register

items: I can say that it makes no difference who, which or where, in several ways.
I can say however much and whatever it is with por más que and a repeated subjunctive.
I can read and write short notices in formal Spanish.
I can read a short text about José Eustasio Rivera and La vorágine.
